channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Trama golpista: defesa pede anulação de condenação e que Bolsonaro seja absolvido
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro has requested a criminal review from the Brazilian Supreme Court (STF) to overturn his conviction for attempted coup d'état, claiming judicial error and lack of jurisdiction by the First Chamber. They seek annulment of the trial, nullification of Mauro Cid's plea bargain, and Bolsonaro's acquittal, citing violation of defense rights and arguing the case should be heard by the full Court. Criminal review is an exceptional remedy available only after a sentence has become final and unappealable.

item.title: Flávio: Se Jair Bolsonaro quiser exercer cargo no meu governo, é óbvio que vai
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, admitted he would appoint former president Jair Bolsonaro to a position in his potential government if the father wished to hold public office. The statement was made on Friday, the 8th, reinforcing the possibility of a family ticket in the 2026 presidential race. Flávio emphasized that such an appointment would be 'obvious' if Jair expressed interest.

item.title: Clica e Confirma destaca o término da gestão da ministra Cármen Lúcia como presidente do TSE
item.description: The Clica e Confirma program highlighted the end of Minister Cármen Lúcia's term as president of the TSE, concluding her second term that began in June 2024. It also covered the upcoming swearing-in of Minister Nunes Marques as the new TSE president on Tuesday (12), with Minister André Mendonça as vice-president, the unveiling of the 2026 elections mascot 'Pilili', and an interview on the new Conta Mais JE campaign finance system.

item.title: Messi revela suas maiores apostas para ganhar a Copa do Mundo
item.description: Lionel Messi stated that France and Spain are his top picks to win the 2026 World Cup, citing their high-level squads. He acknowledged Argentina arrives well and can dream of the title, but believes other teams are in better form. Messi also noted Brazil remains a title contender despite not being at its peak, and reaffirmed his passion for the game, saying he intends to play as long as his body allows.

item.title: Lula diz que Enel não cumpriu nada do que prometeu
item.description: President Lula criticized Enel for failing to fulfill any of its promises to the government during the 'Sente a Energia' event in Brasília. The company was excluded from the early renewal of concession contracts for 14 electricity distributors, involving R$130 billion in investments through 2030. Lula emphasized that the new agreements include stricter quality targets, and non-compliance could lead to concession revocation.

item.title: “Temos que desaprender a ideia de que o homem é superior”, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula called for unlearning the idea of male superiority, stating that violence against women is a men's issue and that jealousy is a disease. He criticized the cultural upbringing that teaches men to feel ownership over women and emphasized respect and love in relationships. The speech, delivered at the 'Sente a Energia' event ahead of the 2026 elections, aligns with the government's strategy to focus on women's living conditions and reducing female workload.

item.title: Governadora do DF insiste em reunião com Lula em busca de ajuda para tentar salvar BRB
item.description: The governor of the Federal District, Celina Leão (PP), is seeking a meeting with President Lula to obtain federal assistance for the capitalization of the Bank of Brasília (BRB), which needs R$ 8.8 billion by the end of the month to cover losses from operations with Master. Despite local government pressure, the Planalto Palace has not yet confirmed the meeting, and the economic team has signaled that the National Treasury will not approve the R$ 6.6 billion loan via the FGC, advocating that any solution must come from the Central Bank, such as intervention and subsequent federalization.

item.title: Lula atribui caso Master à gestão Bolsonaro
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva blamed the Jair Bolsonaro administration for irregularities under investigation in the Banco Master case, stating that the alleged frauds originated in the previous government. The statement was read by Federal Police Director General Andrei Rodrigues during a graduation ceremony at the National Police Academy in Brasília.

item.title: Governo cassará distribuidoras de energia que falharem com frequência
item.description: The federal government announced it will cancel concessions of electricity distributors that repeatedly fail to provide adequate service, under a presidential decree renewing contracts for 16 companies across 13 states. The new rules establish strict criteria for service continuity (FEC and DEC), economic-financial management, climate resilience, rural service, and energy inclusion, with heavy fines and potential contract termination for extreme non-compliance. Minister Alexandre Silveira stated the decree equips Aneel with tools to hold distributors accountable, rendering previous contracts obsolete.

item.title: Flávio diz que prefere mulher como vice e comenta caso Ciro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated he prefers a woman as his vice-presidential running mate and said the decision will be made closer to party conventions. He commented on the investigations against Ciro Nogueira, asserting that Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça, the case’s rapporteur, will act within the law, and emphasized he is not negotiating individual support with Nogueira but with the Progressistas-União Brasil federation.

item.title: Lula diz que falou a Trump que não quer 'guerra' com ele e que sua disputa é 'na narrativa'
item.description: President Lula stated that in his meeting with Donald Trump at the White House, he told Trump he does not seek 'war' with him, but a dispute 'in the narrative,' arguing that Brazil has a trade surplus with the U.S., not a deficit. He described the meeting as productive and reassuring, emphasizing cooperation on organized crime and tariffs, with the next 30 days being crucial for trade negotiations.

item.title: Não quero guerra, quero provar que estamos certos, diz Lula sobre Trump
item.description: President Lula told Donald Trump that Brazil does not seek war with the U.S., but wants to prove it is right regarding trade claims. He noted the trade balance favors the U.S. and called the American justification for tariffs a mistake. Lula gave 30 days to resolve the tariff issue, with a follow-up talk planned.

item.title: Ouvidoria em Foco: busca por regularização eleitoral provoca aumento nos atendimentos do TSE
item.description: The TSE Ombudsman recorded 2,604 attendances between May 1 and 7, exceeding more than half of April’s total demand. The surge was driven by citizens seeking electoral regularization before the voter registry closure, with 80.3% of requests related to voter enrollment, data review, address transfer, and biometric collection. Phone contact was the dominant channel, accounting for 1,688 calls (70.5% of total), a 39.8% increase compared to April.

item.title: Nunes Marques arquiva ação de Bolsonaro contra Lula e Gleisi no STF por crimes contra a honra
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Nunes Marques dismissed a lawsuit filed by former President Jair Bolsonaro against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and federal deputy Gleisi Hoffmann on charges of crimes against honor, following the recommendation of the Attorney General’s Office. The ruling was issued on Thursday, November 7, and terminated the case without substantive review. The decision reflects the Court’s pattern of rejecting politically motivated claims with little legal merit.

item.title: TSE realiza Teste de Confirmação do Teste Público da Urna de 13 a 15 de maio
item.description: The TSE is conducting the Confirmation Test of the 2025 Electronic Voting Machine Public Test from May 13 to 15, where researchers return to validate corrections and improvements made to the electoral systems following the December 2025 phase. The goal is to confirm that identified vulnerabilities have been effectively addressed in time for the 2026 General Elections, scheduled for October 4 and 25 (first and second rounds). Journalists wishing to attend must register by 8 a.m. on May 13 to access the Electoral Dissemination Center in Brasília.

item.title: Lei da Dosimetria é publicada e passa a valer mas redução de penas não é automática; entenda
item.description: The Dosimetry Law was promulgated and published in the Official Gazette, officially taking effect, but sentence reductions for those convicted in the January 8 attacks are not automatic and require action by the Supreme Federal Court (STF) to recalculate penalties. At least 190 people, including Jair Bolsonaro and his allies, could benefit, although a request by the defense of Debora Rodrigues dos Santos was previously rejected due to the law not yet being in force.

item.title: Cármen Lúcia dá 5 dias para Moro se defender em processo de calúnia contra Gilmar Mendes
item.description: Justice Cármen Lúcia of the Supreme Federal Court has given Senator Sérgio Moro five days to submit a preliminary defense in a criminal case for slander against Justice Gilmar Mendes. The accusation stems from a video in which Moro allegedly falsely accused Mendes of passive corruption during a June festival. The Prosecutor General's Office claims Moro acted with full awareness and intent to slander the STF's dean.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: “Dona Maria” do PT? Inteligência Artificial entra na guerra política
item.description: Left-wing profiles supporting Lula’s government created an AI-generated version of the 'Dona Maria' character to attack the president. Originally a satirical critique of the government, the character was appropriated by PT sympathizers as a counter-attack in the digital political war. The episode highlights the growing use of AI in narrative battles between opposition and government bases on social media.

item.title: #NÃO É BEM ASSIM: Voos da FAB com apenas um passageiro foram investigados no governo Lula, mas também no governo Bolsonaro
item.description: A TCU audit between 2020 and 2024 identified 111 FAB flights with only one passenger, occurring under both Bolsonaro and Lula administrations. Social media posts falsely attributed all flights solely to Lula, ignoring the bipartisan timeframe. Journalist Adriana Araújo criticized the misuse of public resources, contrasting it with social needs like INSS queues and lack of school meals.

item.title: O foco de tensão que o encontro Lula-Trump pode ter desarmado, segundo Celso Amorim
item.description: Celso Amorim stated that the Lula-Trump meeting defused the risk of classifying Brazilian criminal factions as terrorists, maintaining focus on joint action against organized crime without changing the 'label' of these groups. Brazil fears legal and sovereignty implications if groups like PCC and CV were designated terrorist, given their profit-driven, non-ideological nature.

item.title: Lula diz que, em reunião na Casa Branca, afirmou a Trump que não quer 'guerra' com ele
item.description: Lula stated that during his meeting with Donald Trump at the White House, he told the U.S. president he does not want 'war' with him, advocating for dialogue based on facts rather than confrontation. He criticized the tariffs imposed by the U.S. on Brazil as a 'mistake', noting the trade balance favors the U.S., and gave 30 days for the trade ministries of both countries to resolve the tariff issue.

item.title: Tarcísio nega prejuízo com operação, e PP de Ciro Nogueira cancela ato para apoio eleitoral em SP
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas downplayed the impact of investigations against Senator Ciro Nogueira on his electoral campaign, defending the inquiries into the Banco Master case. Ciro Nogueira's PP canceled an electoral support event in São Paulo, likely due to investigative pressure. Tarcísio sought to distance his image from the allegations against his political ally.

item.title: TSE realiza neste sábado (9) manutenção na infraestrutura de Tecnologia da Informação
item.description: The TSE is conducting IT infrastructure maintenance this Saturday (9) from 10 PM to 2 AM Sunday (10) to enhance performance and security. During this window, the TSE and TREs portals, as well as SEI and PJe systems, may be unavailable, with stabilization expected to take up to six additional hours after the update.

item.title: Carlos Viana diz que CPMI já sabia sobre Ciro Nogueira
item.description: Senator Carlos Viana (PSD-MG), president of the INSS Parliamentary Inquiry Committee (CPMI), stated that the committee was already aware that the Federal Police would investigate Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP), who was subject to a search and seizure warrant in Operation Compliance Zero. Viana said the CPMI had forwarded documents to the Supreme Court and the Attorney General’s Office pointing to an alleged influence, power, and corruption network operating behind the scenes in Brasília, involving the Centrão, political parties, and government sectors, and denounced pressures and sabotage attempts against committee members.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro sobre dosimetria: Lula teve oportunidade de promulgar, mas escolheu 'omissăo'
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president in 2026, stated that the promulgation of the dosimetry law represents an opportunity to 'turn the page, pacify the country' and overcome what he described as President Lula's 'omission,' claiming Lulu had the chance to sanction the norm but chose not to act.

item.title: STF forma maioria e mantém prefeito tiktoker de Sorocaba no cargo
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) formed a majority to keep Sorocaba's mayor Rodrigo Manga (Republicanos) in office, overturning the TRF-3's removal order. The decision upholds the injunction by Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, supported by Toffoli and Mendonça, while Fux and Gilmar Mendes have yet to vote. Manga is under investigation for alleged embezzlement of public health funds in Operation Copia e Cola.

item.title: Alvo da PF, Ciro Nogueira fala em ‘perseguição política’ e descarta renúncia ao mandato
item.description: Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI), targeted in a Federal Police operation investigating the Banco Master case, denounced political persecution and rejected any possibility of resigning his mandate. He claimed the operation seeks to tarnish his honor but said his commitment to the people strengthens him. The PF alleged monthly payments of R$300,000 to R$500,000 from banker Daniel Vorcaro to the senator, with asset freezes totaling R$18.85 million ordered by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça.

item.title: STF tem 4 votos contra o monitoramento de jornalistas e parlamentares nas redes
item.description: The STF has a 4-1 partial vote to declare unconstitutional the federal government's monitoring of journalists and parliamentarians on social media, in an action filed by the PV in 2020 during Bolsonaro's government. Rapporteur Cármen Lúcia was supported by Moraes, Barroso and Weber, while André Mendonça dissented. Kassio Nunes Marques initially requested a highlight but later withdrew it; Fux, Mendes, Zanin, Fachin and Toffoli remain to vote.

item.title: Dólar cai a R$ 4,89, menor valor desde janeiro de 2024. Bolsa sobe
item.description: The dollar fell to R$ 4.89, its lowest level since January 2024, as markets reacted positively to Donald Trump's statements on ceasefires in Ukraine and Iran. The Ibovespa rose 0.49%, partially reversing the previous day's decline, supported by strong U.S. employment data showing 115,000 jobs created in April — well above forecasts.

item.title: Crusoé: O funk terapêutico do Pilili (ou da Pilili)
item.description: An AI-generated satirical video titled 'Funk da Urninha Eletrônica' by the Canta Direita channel is described as therapeutic due to its creative use of the TSE's Pilili mascot, blending humor and critique of Brazil's 2026 elections. The video combines absurd imagery and vivid details to produce a comedic, cathartic effect for viewers.

item.title: Eleições 2026: arrecadação via financiamento coletivo começa no dia 15 de maio
item.description: Starting May 15, pre-candidates in Brazil’s 2026 General Elections can raise funds through crowdfunding, or 'virtual piggy bank', by contracting with TSE-approved institutions. Four companies are currently authorized: AppCívico Consultoria Ltda, Elegis Gestão Estratégica, GMT Tecnologia, and QueroApoiar.com.br Ltda. Two others, Livepix and Vale Apoio Inova Simples (i.S), have pending registration.

item.title: Governo estudou dinâmicas de outras reuniões de Trump com presidentes para evitar hostilidade contra Lula
item.description: The Lula government studied Trump's tense meetings with Zelensky and Ramaphosa to avoid hostility during the White House encounter, requesting that press enter only after the meeting to prevent escalation. The strategy succeeded, as Trump adopted a friendlier tone with Lula, while Vance made only a brief initial intervention. The meeting, brokered by Joesley Batista, took place without journalists in the Oval Office during negotiations.

item.title: Operação contra Ciro Nogueira faz clima pesar entre lideranças do Centrão
item.description: The fifth phase of Operation Compliance Zero, investigating alleged financial fraud linked to Banco Master, targeted PP national president Ciro Nogueira, causing embarrassment and caution among Centrão leaders. The operation raised concerns about further developments and potential investigations against other bloc members, prompting some to reconsider their support for Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential bid. Centrão leaders now argue they must 'clean house' before resuming opposition to Lula’s government, expecting Flávio Bolsonaro’s team to maintain a protocolary distance from the bloc for now.

item.title: Lula entregou a Trump lista de brasileiros punidos e cobrou resolução
item.description: President Lula handed Donald Trump a list of approximately 20 Brazilian officials under U.S. sanctions, including Supreme Court ministers, prosecutors, and family members, requesting a review of these measures initiated in July 2025. He noted that while some sanctions were eased, such as Moraes’ removal from the Magnitsky List in December 2025, most remain in effect and pledged to raise the issue again in future meetings. Lula also joked about the 2026 World Cup and visas for Brazilian players during the encounter.

item.title: Trump respeita quem se mostra firme e altivo como Lula, diz ex-embaixador nos EUA
item.description: Former ambassador Roberto Abdenur says Donald Trump respects leaders who show firmness and altivez, like President Lula, whose Washington meeting yielded a positive social media post and progress in Brazil-U.S. relations. However, Abdenur warns that Secretary of State Marco Rubio still views Lula as a dangerous leftist, posing a lingering point of tension.

item.title: Tarcísio sobre Master: “Deve ser investigado, doa a quem doer”
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) stated that suspicions surrounding Banco Master must be investigated 'no matter who it hurts,' following a federal police operation against Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI), a political ally. He downplayed the postponement of a PP event endorsing his re-election bid and insisted the case 'has nothing to do with us,' despite Nogueira's support for Tarcísio's Senate ally, Guilherme Derrite.

item.title: Trump evitou discutir Pix e facções brasileiras em reunião com Lula
item.description: President Trump avoided discussing Brazil's Pix payment system and criminal factions during his three-hour meeting with Lula at the White House, a silence interpreted by the Brazilian government as indicating these issues are not currently a priority for Washington. Brasilia viewed the outcome positively, having refrained from raising topics not prompted by the U.S., including digital platform regulation, to avoid prematurely engaging in unfavorable debates under the Section 301 trade investigation framework.

item.title: Governo Lula avalia concessões aos EUA para evitar tarifaço e que reunião com Trump serviu para ganhar tempo
item.description: The Lula government is considering making concessions to the United States to avoid the imposition of high tariffs stemming from an investigation based on Section 301 of the U.S. Trade Act of 1974. The meeting between Lula and Trump in Washington was seen as an effort to buy time, though government officials believe some concession is necessary to end the process. Full access to the article requires a subscription.

item.title: Organizações publicam manifesto contra manobras para manutenção de penduricalhos e supersalários após decisão do STF
item.description: Eight civil society organizations, including República.org, Transparência Internacional, and Transparência Brasil, published a manifesto criticating public sector maneuvers to circumvent the March 2026 STF ruling that limited penduricalhos (additional payments). They state that at least R$20 billion above the constitutional ceiling was paid between August 2024 and July 2025, through tactics like equating judges to professors and unrestricted accumulation of benefits, and condemn the lack of effective action by the three branches of government to curb supersalaries.

item.title: Alcolumbre promulga PL da Dosimetria, que reduz pena de Bolsonaro
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre promulgated the Dosimetry Law after Congress overturned President Lula’s veto, potentially reducing sentences for those convicted of the January 8 acts, including Jair Bolsonaro. Approved in December 2025 as an alternative to amnesty, the law requires Supreme Court validation to take effect. The promulgation without presidential sanction underscores escalating tensions between the Executive and Legislative branches, following two government defeats in 24 hours.

item.title: Encontro entre Lula e Trump: o impacto no bolsonarismo e a avaliação nos bastidores
item.description: The meeting between Lula and Trump in Washington was seen as a political victory for the Brazilian president, marked by the temporary suspension of U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods for 30 days and discussions on access to critical minerals and rare earths. Despite domestic wear and tear, including the defeat of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF, Lula extended the meeting from 30 minutes to nearly three hours and received public praise from Trump, weakening the narrative of the Brazilian right. Analysts said the gesture had symbolic impact and strengthened Lula's image amid commercial and political tensions.

item.title: Dá para confiar nos EUA? Economista analisa encontro Lula e Trump
item.description: The meeting between Lula and Trump was politically positive for avoiding tensions, yet it has not yet produced concrete economic effects. Economist Patrícia Krause notes the meeting served to open a dialogue channel and reduce political noise, but the market awaits objective measures, particularly on tariffs. Although the 30-day negotiation period is seen as a positive signal, it is considered insufficient to resolve long-standing trade disputes.

item.title: Governo renova concessões de energia em 13 Estados, com investimentos de R$ 130 bi
item.description: The Lula government announced the early renewal of electricity distribution concessions for 14 companies across 13 states, projecting R$130 billion in investments through 2030. The move aims to prevent investment stagnation by imposing stricter contractual rules on service quality, transparency, oversight, and technological modernization. Enel was excluded due to an ongoing Aneel process over recurring supply failures, while Light’s renewal was confirmed with a R$10 billion commitment to upgrade Rio de Janeiro’s grid.

item.title: É #FAKE vídeo de Flávio Bolsonaro dizendo que vai criar 'auxílio sacolão de osso'; áudio foi manipulado com IA
item.description: A video circulating on social media shows Flávio Bolsonaro claiming he will create a 'bone basket allowance', but the content is an AI-manipulated edit of a genuine video from November 2024. Detection tools confirmed high probability of voice cloning, with up to 98% likelihood the audio was artificially generated. The original video contains no mention of such aid and was taken out of context to spread misinformation.

item.title: Ciro Nogueira diz ser alvo de perseguição política após ação da PF
item.description: Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI) accused the Federal Police of political persecution after being targeted in Operation Compliance Zero, which investiges alleged frauds linked to Banco Master. He linked the investigation to the 2026 electoral year, recalling a similar episode in 2018 when he was cleared by the STF following Lava Jato allegations. Nogueira claimed the attacks strengthen his campaign and his commitment to Piauí voters.

item.title: Na Casa Branca, Lula convidou Donald Trump a visitar o Brasil
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva invited U.S. President Donald Trump to visit Brazil during a meeting at the White House. The invitation was made in a relaxed setting, with Lula noting he had previously made the same request in phone calls. Aides said Trump thanked Lula for the invitation but did not give a concrete response on whether he would accept or when he might visit.

item.title: Em SC, Flávio lança pré-candidatura ao Planalto no sábado
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro will launch his presidential pre-candidacy in Florianópolis (SC) on Saturday, alongside his brother Carlos Bolsonaro (pre-candidate for Senate) and other PL candidates in the state. A Futura/Apex poll shows Flávio would defeat Lula in Santa Catarina in a potential runoff, while a national Real Time Big Data survey indicates a technical tie between the two, with Flávio holding a slight edge in the second round (44% to 43%).

item.title: Crusoé: Caso Master precisa ser apurado “doa a quem doer”, diz Tarcísio
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas stated that the Banco Master scandal must be investigated thoroughly, 'come what may', one day after the Federal Police launched the fifth phase of Operation Compliance Zero, targeting Senator Ciro Nogueira. The operation investigates alleged illicit financial flows and connections between the bank and political figures.

item.title: Gilmar sobre impeachment: “Não me assusto com esse tipo de ameaça”
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Gilmar Mendes said he is not intimidated by threats of impeachment against justices, in response to a campaign by PL pre-candidates supporting such measures. He defended the STF’s independence and stated these attempts do not frighten him. The remarks were made in an interview with BandNews radio on Friday, the 8th.

item.title: Master: Tarcísio reage à operação da PF que mirou aliado Ciro Nogueira
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas defended the Federal Police investigation into the Banco Master scandal involving Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP), stating that the probe must proceed regardless of who is involved. He downplayed the postponement of a PP-organized event in support of his re-election, emphasizing the strength of his political alliance, which includes Republicans, PL, PSD, MDP, PP, União, and Podemos.
